visualAssets.description: Interactive 12-node flooded industrial archipelago nautical chart with animated radar sweep, hazard route badges, depth contours, and Iron Skiff vessel token.
8-Slot boat hold schematic showing real-time slot allocation across Cargo Crates, Installed Boat Modules, Fuel Drums, and Repair Kits.
Custom vector hazard badges for Scrap Reef, Cross-Current Riptide, Acid Squall, Floating Minefield, Silt Fogbank, and Rogue Wake.

audioAssets.description: Low-frequency sawtooth/triangle modulated workboat diesel engine chug on node transit.
Detuned dual-oscillator brassy industrial foghorn blast on port departure and victory.
High-Q resonant sine ping with exponential decay for route selection and hazard scan.
Metallic impact noise burst + sub-bass thud when taking hull damage or equipping modules.
Two-tone mechanical cash register bell on contract payout.
